- Do you need us to coordinate procurement for any purchase order or attending logistics (invoice routing)?

- Amy Liu (FinCo) — security lead (if available)

- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — SE / demo owner

I attached a preliminary attendee list and a short checklist for ops clearance. If we need a physical escort on demo day, let us know and we'll coordinate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 if that helps.
